title: Emergency Medical Technician (EMT)
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 16S/24Q to fewer than 30S/45Q units

program.section_heading: Emergency Medical Technician (EMT) Certificate of Achievement
outcomes: Demonstrate proficiency in emergency medical care, including the ability to perform essential EMT skills and apply critical thinking to manage emergencies effectively.
Exhibit strong teamwork, communication, and leadership abilities within a simulated field environment, preparing for successful integration into fire service and emergency response teams

notes: The catalog prints course codes without a space (BIO4, FT183, FT183L, KIN13); these match closed-list BIO 4, FT 183, FT 183L and KIN 13.
FT183L is printed at 2.5 credits in the catalog, while the state file stores 1 unit; the catalog's 16.5 total reflects 2.5.
The second program outcome is printed without a final period; copied as printed.

The description also mentions working in an ambulance, preparing for a Physician Assistant (PA) program, completing fire academy, and certification as a certified EMT; these were not recorded as careers because they are activities, pathways or a credential rather than named occupations. A reviewer may wish to check this.
Program Map sections (Spring Start with Summer, Fall Start, Spring Start) list the same four required courses and were not recorded as separate blocks.
